acceptanceCriteria.text: Trusted-main canonical integration exercises the production `SystemLimaCli` / production Lima configuration path for affected host-bootstrap/Runtime composition changes.
The proof consumes the real canonical Runtime Appliance artifact/identity, not a surrogate guest.

The proof verifies at least production create/start composition, bounded SSH reachability, and handoff to the canonical guest-health boundary using the same product configuration path as `runtime ensure`.
A regression substitution equivalent to #840 (missing `MTNAI_BOOT` delivery) fails the production composition gate.
A regression substitution equivalent to #841 (normal Lima cloud-init readiness instead of canonical plain-mode behavior) fails the gate.
The proof does not claim real-host KVM/provider support certification; #261 remains the final external real-host authority.
PR-tier CI remains rejection-oriented and does not automatically inherit the full trusted-main cost for host-bootstrap-only changes.
CI ownership/selection contract tests prove the new trusted-main production-Lima proof is selected whenever a change can invalidate that boundary.

issue.title: fix: exercise the production Lima composition path on trusted main
